_meta.purpose: Paste-ready business listing copy for Google Business Profile and the directories that give cushlabs.ai its first backlinks. English and Mexican Professional Spanish (es-MX) for every text field.
_meta.why: Ahrefs Domain Rating 5 = one referring domain. Each published listing that links to https://www.cushlabs.ai/ is one more. Google Business Profile is the one most likely to bring Mexican local search traffic.
rules_applied: Only Facebook Messenger is named without a plan qualifier. Instagram, website chat and the voice agent are named only as 'on higher plans', because they start at Premium or Ultra.
WhatsApp is named only as the owner alert, never as a channel the assistant answers on.
No prices in descriptions: they go stale on sites nobody re-checks. Price lives in 'pricing_for_forms', used only where a form insists.
'Bilingual' describes the assistant, never Robert. No career-year totals.
No 'trained on'. The assistant answers from information the client approves.

English copy is written for US buyers (the ICP's US segment): it leads with answering Spanish-speaking customers and does not frame the service as Mexico-only. It makes no claim about the language of the WhatsApp owner alert, which is unverified. Spanish copy is written for Mexico and is used on Google, Bing and Apple.
_meta.language_note: Google Business Profile, Bing and Apple each allow ONE description. Use the Spanish (es) text there: the target customer searches in Spanish and Google translates for English speakers. Use English where the directory audience is US buyers (Clutch, GoodFirms, DesignRush, Sortlist, Crunchbase). LinkedIn allows both: set English as the primary language and add Spanish as a second language.

nap._note: Name, address and phone must be IDENTICAL on every listing, character for character. Inconsistent NAP weakens local ranking.
nap.address_visibility: Hide the street address. Register as a service-area business (you visit or serve customers; they do not come to you).

short_description.en: CushLabs.ai sets up AI assistants that answer your customers 24/7 in Spanish or English and alert you on WhatsApp when a lead is ready to book.
short_description.es: CushLabs.ai configura asistentes con IA que contestan los mensajes de tus clientes 24/7 y te avisan por WhatsApp cuando alguien quiere comprar.

long_description._limit: about 1,500 characters; fits Clutch, GoodFirms, DesignRush, Sortlist, LinkedIn
long_description.en:
Many of your customers would rather write to you in Spanish. When nobody on your team can answer them well, or nobody is around at 9 p.m., those messages wait, and some of those customers buy somewhere else.

CushLabs.ai sets up an AI assistant that answers them for you, 24/7, in Spanish or English, following whatever language each customer writes in. It starts with Facebook Messenger. On higher plans, the same assistant also answers Instagram comments and DMs, chats on your website, and picks up your phone line.

The assistant answers only from the information you approve: your services, prices, hours and policies. When a customer is ready to book, or asks for a person, it captures their details and sends you a WhatsApp alert, so you can follow up yourself.

We also help you answer your Google reviews, with your approval on every reply.

Everything is fully managed. We handle setup, load your business information, send weekly reports and tune the assistant every month. You don't have to learn new software. There is no setup fee and no contract, and you start with a 1-week free trial.

CushLabs.ai was founded by Robert Cushman, who led technology projects at Fortune 500 company Praxair (now Linde): more than 100 global initiatives supporting 26,000 employees in 42 countries. CushLabs.ai is based in Guadalajara, Mexico, and serves businesses in the United States and Mexico.
long_description.es:
CushLabs.ai configura asistentes con IA que contestan a tus clientes por ti, 24/7. Empezamos por Facebook Messenger, que es donde la mayoría de los negocios en México ya reciben sus mensajes. En los planes más completos, el mismo asistente también responde comentarios y mensajes directos en Instagram, atiende el chat de tu sitio web y contesta tu línea telefónica.

El asistente responde solo con la información que tú apruebas: tus servicios, precios, horarios y políticas. Contesta en español o en inglés, según el idioma en que te escriba el cliente. Cuando alguien está listo para agendar, o pide hablar con una persona, toma sus datos y te avisa por WhatsApp para que le des seguimiento desde la app que ya usas.

También te ayudamos a responder tus reseñas de Google, siempre con tu aprobación en cada respuesta.

Nosotros nos encargamos de todo: la configuración, la carga de la información de tu negocio, los reportes semanales y los ajustes de cada mes. No tienes que aprender a usar otra aplicación. No hay costo de instalación ni contrato, y empiezas con una prueba gratis de 1 semana.

CushLabs.ai fue fundada por Robert Cushman, quien dirigió proyectos de tecnología en Praxair (hoy Linde), empresa de Fortune 500: más de 100 iniciativas globales para 26,000 empleados en 42 países. Hoy aplica esa misma disciplina a negocios pequeños y locales. CushLabs.ai está en Guadalajara y atiende negocios en México y Estados Unidos.
